Justified adaptation: upstream Docker image tags are lowercase while repository cache paths preserve case. The generic connector resolves one matching identity, rejects collisions/unsafe or changed records, and normalizes only its staging copy for the unchanged upstream inline emitter. Raw inputs/cache JSON/source stay unchanged. Only the official Dockerfile and reproducibility metadata change; tests, patches, grading settings/assets, parser/reward, timeouts and resource profile are audited unchanged. Normal old-plan execution remains rejected.

186 tests, distribution/install, lint/format/types/hooks pass. Actual pinned API fixtures reproduce baseline mixed-case failure and candidate success, retaining the official timestamp difference in the lower-case comparison. The noneditable installed consumer verifies actual #62 with network/subprocess/credential reads/file writes forbidden; old source and budget stay byte-inert. Normal CLI local export and replay preserve original/consumer inputs and budget. Fresh SDK fingerprint matches the original configured profile. There is one frozen supported export, no unsupported input, and no native control submitted yet.

Current settled ledger: $1.723023/48 original calls, 13.678993889/32 CPUh, zero CPU/model reservations, existing $10 storage reserve. Reserve at most 6.333333 CPUh for this original control/stop/cleanup lifecycle, projected cumulative 20.012327222<32; zero new model reservation or allowance. Same $90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra, reserved TRC capacity only. Launch loads only authorized CoreWeave credentials; it supplies neither generation admission nor GH/OpenRouter credentials. One finite attempt; observe the original handle on interruption, never resubmit because status observation times out.

#62 remains a preserved stopped connector result. #64’s parser issue and four ordinary suite failures are not repaired or hidden. Independent nop/oracle results, clean-command status, eligible archival/readback and owned cleanup must establish the outcome. No acceptance, merge or release claim; keep issues and PRs open.
